reasons: Cited clauses support the compliant classification: p0017 vests all Works (SOW deliverables/work product) in Company, p0020 limits Contractor to its pre-existing proprietary tools/know-how (a permitted vendor carve-out), and p0021 grants a royalty-free, perpetual, sublicensable licence to use, copy, modify and create derivative versions of any Contractor Information embedded in the Works — i.e. the licence-back the preferred position requires.
No assignment of Customer IP or data to Contractor and no joint ownership appears in the cited text; the deterministic check confirms no residual assignment language, so no walk-away trigger exists.

Shortfalls are correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged: ownership conditioned on invoiced-and-paid periods, licence not expressly stated to be irrevocable/worldwide, and no standalone Customer Data ownership sentence — these are sub-elements short of ideal drafting and do not defeat the fallback.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed; the paragraphs are rendered unchanged, so there is no over-flagging or invalid edit to correct.
